title: ephedra ciliata var. polylepis
intro: Ephedra ciliata var. polylepis, commonly known as the "Mountain Ephedra", is a type of evergreen shrub native to the mountainous regions of Asia and the Himalayas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and providing antioxidant properties to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Ephedra ciliata var. polylepis include acting as an expectorant, bronchodilator, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating respiratory and cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
